about.heroBody: We offer unique places suited for your comfort — curated stays along Egypt's most beautiful coastlines.
about.story1: Soul Hospitality was shaped around one idea: premium homes should feel both effortless and memorable. We curate short stays, longer living arrangements, and owner experiences with the same discipline, so every property is presented with clarity, calm, and consistency.
about.story2: Our team focuses on the details that make hospitality feel refined rather than transactional. From furnishing standards and guest touchpoints to property stewardship and responsive support, every layer is designed to keep the experience warm, clean, and reliable.
about.qualityBody: We maintain a high finish across every unit, from material choices and styling to cleanliness, consistency, and the standard of the guest experience.
about.teamworkBody: Our operations, guest support, and property care teams work as one system so owners and guests feel a smooth, coordinated service at every step.
about.respectBody: We respect every property as an asset, every guest as a priority, and every owner relationship as a long-term partnership built on trust.
about.integrityBody: Clear communication, transparent operations, and honest reporting guide how we manage bookings, care plans, and everyday hospitality decisions.
about.responsibilityBody: We take ownership of the details that protect value over time, keeping the property experience organised, dependable, and carefully maintained.
about.innovativeBody: We refine service flows, presentation, and digital touchpoints so the brand feels modern without losing the calm and luxury expected from Soul.

down_payment_dropped.title: Down payments that dropped out of “paid”
down_payment_dropped.what: These stays had a down payment kept only on the reservation; once another payment was recorded, the down payment stopped counting.
down_payment_dropped.fix: Record each down payment as a payment so the stay shows the right balance.

pre_reset_payments.title: Money received for stays from before the restart
pre_reset_payments.what: These stays were booked and started before the books restart, so the new books never opened what the guest owed. The money received is booked as a correction to opening equity.
pre_reset_payments.fix: Confirm with finance that these balances were really owed at the restart.

vendor_paid_not_booked.title: Paid vendor bills without a “paid from” account
vendor_paid_not_booked.what: These bills were paid before the books asked which account paid them, so the payment is booked against ADIB.
vendor_paid_not_booked.fix: If one was paid from CIB or cash, record a manual journal moving it to that account.

write_offs_not_applied.title: Write-offs waiting for approval
write_offs_not_applied.what: Until a write-off is approved, the amount stays on Outstanding and in the guest receivable.
write_offs_not_applied.fix: Approve or reject it on Outstanding › Follow-up & write-offs.

placeholders.title: “Awaiting collection” placeholders
placeholders.what: Pending payments created automatically for manual stays. They are not money received but some screens count them.
placeholders.fix: Cancel them once the stay is collected.

card_without_stay.title: Card payments with no stay
card_without_stay.what: A guest paid by card more than 2 days ago and no reservation was created from the booking.
card_without_stay.fix: Open the website booking requests and accept or refund the booking.

collection_waiting.title: Down payments waiting more than 3 days
collection_waiting.what: These payments have been in Reservation collection for more than 3 days.
collection_waiting.fix: Check the amount and method and confirm them.

overpaid.title: Stays paid more than their bill
overpaid.what: More money is recorded as paid than the full bill. Usually a duplicate payment or a missing fee line.
overpaid.fix: Open the stay, then cancel the duplicate payment or add the missing line.

bank_not_reconciled.title: Banks not reconciled in the last 35 days
bank_not_reconciled.what: No bank statement balance was entered recently, so the bank figures are not confirmed against the statement.
bank_not_reconciled.fix: Enter the latest statement balance in Bank & cards.

closed_month_edits.title: Changes to stays in closed months
closed_month_edits.what: These stays were edited or paid after their month was closed, which changes closed figures.
closed_month_edits.fix: Review each change; reopen the month or post a correction.

unbalanced_entries.title: Journal entries that do not balance
unbalanced_entries.what: Every entry must have equal debits and credits. These do not, so the statements will not tie.
unbalanced_entries.fix: Open the entry and correct the record behind it.

wrong_side_balances.title: Accounts on the wrong side
wrong_side_balances.what: A bank, cash, receivable, deposit, insurance or owner account has a negative balance, which usually means money was recorded against the wrong account or an opening balance is missing.
wrong_side_balances.fix: Open the account, find the entry that pushed it negative and correct it, or add the missing opening balance.
